reason: I'd probably try the free tricks at Friday dinner, but I'm not typing my card into some website for an app that isn't even in the App Store. If it's not on the store, I don't know who's behind it or how to get my money back.
objection: Paying 99 shekels by card on an unknown site for an app installed from the browser - no store, no reviews I trust, no refund if the tricks turn out to look fake.
would_change_my_mind: If it were sold through the App Store or Google Play with real reviews, and the free tricks actually fooled my family at dinner.
